CHANNEL_API_URL.description: The base URL of Slack's Web API, ending in a slash.

CHANNEL_TOKEN.description: The Slack bot token (xoxb-...) with chat:write, users:read and channels:history. Required by every command.

CHANNEL_SIGNING_SECRET.description: The signing secret of the Slack app. receive refuses a delivery whose X-Slack-Signature does not match, or that Slack signed more than 5 minutes from now.

OSF_NOW.description: The current time, like 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, that receive compares with X-Slack-Request-Timestamp. Default: the clock.
